landing.title: Budgets
landing.subtitle: Two approaches, two philosophies. Pick the one that fits — you can switch at any time.

plafonds.title: Caps
plafonds.pitch: Set a limit per category and let the app warn you when you're close to crossing it. Loose, after-the-fact tracking.

envelopes.title: Envelopes
envelopes.pitch: Assign every euro of income to a category before spending it. Strict YNAB-style approach, full control.

header.title: Budgets
header.subtitle: Set a monthly limit per category and see at a glance whether you're on track. For strict "every euro has a job" allocation, see Envelopes.
